During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] of [[Naboo]] conducted a '''mission to Toydaria''' in a bid to persuade the [[Planet|world's]] [[Toydarian Ministry Council|government]] to allow for [[Toydaria]] to be used as a staging ground for relief supplies to be delivered to the embattled [[Ryloth]]. This was interrupted by the [[Trade Federation]], whose representative in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate|Senate]], [[Lott Dod]], entered into [[King]] [[Katuunko]]'s council chamber along with an [[Unidentified Neimoidian aide (Lott Dod)|aide]] and spoke against Organa and Binks' plea.

The Toydarians ultimately gave a [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth|legal decision]] on their stance in the matter of using Toydarian territory to aid the [[Jedi]] and the Republic in the humanitarian crisis on [[Ryloth]].<ref name="Supply Lines" />
